pages.title: Fortress Battles
text: Fortress Battle is a weekly event that spans 8 weeks, completing a season. During this event, alliances can compete for control of Fortresses on the World Map and earn incredible rewards.
There are 16 buildings in total, including 12 Fortresses and 4 Strongholds, each with its own set of rewards. To view the specific rewards for a Fortress, simply tap on it.

Every week, alliances have the opportunity to select one Fortress and one Stronghold to fight for in the current event. The Fortresses won in the previous week will automatically be registered for the next event. However, there is a limit of 14 Fortresses that can be automatically registered for challenge.
Once the 8-week season concludes, all Fortresses will reset and come under the control of the Phaethon Mercenaries.
A fortress event is an event that starts from the beginning of the server opening. I’d like to write down the basics so that many people can quickly adapt to the event at first.
The compensation that people are most confused about is written separately below.

During the registration stage, Alliance R5/R4 can choose which Fortresses they want to take. They can choose three preferred start times out of five options that work best for their alliance. However, the final battle time will be determined based on the most voted time slot in your state.

If an Alliance successfully captured a Stronghold or Fortress in the previous event, they will auto-register to compete for the same building in the following event of the season. Here’s an example to illustrate this scenario:

Season 1 Week 1: Register for 1 stronghold and 1 fortress. Week 2: Auto-registered for 1 stronghold and 1 fortress + can register for 1 stronghold and 1 fortress. Week 3: Auto-registered for 2 strongholds and 2 fortresses + can register for 1 stronghold and 1 fortress. Week 4: Auto-registered for 3 strongholds and 3 fortresses + can register for 1 stronghold and 1 fortress. Week 5: Auto-registered for 4 fortresses and 4 strongholds + can register for 1 fortress. Week 6: Auto-registered for 5 fortresses and 4 strongholds + can register for 1 fortress. Week 7: Auto-registered for 6 fortresses and 4 strongholds + can register for 1 fortress. Week 8: Auto-registered for 7 fortresses and 4 strongholds + can register for 1 fortress.

During the event, Alliances can send troops to occupy the registered Fortresses. Each Fortress has a challenge period of one hour. Any registered alliance can strive for control by continuously occupying a Fortress for 30 minutes. If no alliance can maintain control within this time frame, the alliance in control of the Fortress at the end of the one-hour period will take full control.
Attention: The hero fragments indicated vary depending on the generation of heroes in your state.
